subject.title: chore(deps): bump the android-deps group across 1 directory with 2 updates

question: After the PR is rebased and all final-head Android lanes pass, should OpenClaw accept the Kotlin 2.4.10 compiler-behavior change for the Android app?
rationale: Compiler patch releases can change generated Compose and serialization behavior in ways that static diff review cannot fully settle, so the Android owner must accept the release compatibility risk.

options.title: Accept after Android proof
options.body: Rebase the PR and merge it once all final-head Android build, test, and lint lanes pass.

options.title: Hold Kotlin 2.4.0
options.body: Close or pause the update if the Android owner wants to defer the compiler behavior change to a coordinated tooling upgrade.

recommendation.title: Accept after Android proof
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR and merge it once all final-head Android build, test, and lint lanes pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository explicitly assigns the Android app area to @obviyus.
